subject: Variant guidance, hook and timing source implementation
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1
WIRE: CODEX-VARIANT-GUIDANCE-HOOK-TIMING-R1-START-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify SOURCE_REF exactly, copy only the named source, then return one correlated ACK and begin a real source/test delta; finish with one terminal DELIVERY or exact BLOCKED.
REASON: OPEN_ARCHITECTURE_GAP
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: a856f04e71a6e64d78ff8b35bfc36a349c857cac
SOURCE_PRECHECK: The exact commit is authoritative. Fetching the moving branch is allowed only to obtain that exact object; never substitute the branch tip or an older release.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-variant-guidance-hook-timing-r1
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Use this bridge-directory root and do not edit the source checkout, any live release or any other task copy.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, generated output, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
MISSION: Implement the smallest missing source behavior for the existing architecture's selected-guidance attribution and richer hook/format/timing evidence in the variant/A-B workflow. Audit packages/api/src/variant-ab-contract.ts, the authenticated variant-experiments routes, existing asset_variant.settings and content_bundle.captionGuidance/publication snapshot contracts, and the reachable VariantExperimentManager/VariantPublishedPerformance UI before editing. Preserve existing asset_variant, experiment, assignment, review-bundle, publication-attribution and RLS state; do not create a parallel media model.
PASS_1: A copied baseline, pure contract-only change, docs-only claim, or generated output is not delivery. Changed product source must be reachable from an authenticated route and dashboard surface.
PASS_2: Use the existing bounded GuidanceEvidence rules. If existing asset_variant.settings JSONB or another current contract can safely carry the evidence, persist only bounded optional receipt identity, hook type, format and UTC posting-hour/timing bucket, expose it through the existing candidate/performance response, and render truthful evidence/unknown states in the existing UI. Do not accept or invent a guidance receipt that cannot be proven to belong to the same org/model.
PASS_3: If the existing architecture cannot persist or verify this attribution without a new schema or unapproved relation, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact file/contract and why; do not invent a migration or silently store unscoped identifiers.
PASS_4: Preserve tenant/model ownership, platform capability, consent/approval boundaries, idempotency, replay safety, and the rule that experiments never publish directly. No manual self-report becomes verified learning.
PASS_5: Add behavior tests for valid evidence, each invalid hook/format/hour boundary, absent evidence, tenant/model mismatch, bounded candidate/performance projection, guidance attribution aggregation, and truthful unavailable/unknown UI state. Tests must exercise real route/component callsites, not only helper functions.
PASS_6: Run focused tests, typechecks, builds and lint for every changed package; report exact commands and real exit codes. No live provider or database is allowed.
PASS_7: DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed repository-relative paths, SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names/counts, changed-file summary and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. State explicitly that no deployment, installer, migration execution, database, provider, credential, permission, network, systemd or runtime action occurred.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: This lane receives one Codex audit. If a named criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex may send one exact correction receipt. If the corrected artifact fails again or the existing contract is insufficient, return terminal BLOCKED. Do not loop on ACKs, unchanged PROGRESS or helper-only rewrites.
PROTOCOL: Every reply must use strict FT-HERMES/1, correlate with this exact WIRE, include READ_STATUS where required, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
